summary: Iteration 3 (Customer Combos + Bigger Grill upgrade + Daily Special). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests green — new tests cover GET /api/daily-special (shape {date, dish_id, name, emoji, bonus_multiplier=2.0} + determinism across two calls + dish_id in catalog), GET /api/grill-info/{player_id} (grill_level=0, max_level=3, next_cost=150, maxed=false on a new player + player doc has grill_level=0), POST /api/players/{player_id}/upgrade-grill (400 when coins=100<150, then full progression 150→300→450 with grill_level advancing 0→1→2→3, next_cost updates each step, maxed=true and next_cost=null at level 3, extra upgrade rejected with 400). Prior 13 regression tests (root, dishes, shop, player create/get/404, complete-level/unlock, purchase/insufficient/use-booster, leaderboard) still pass with no _id leaks. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) Home / renders daily-special-banner reading 🥩 ⭐ TODAY'S SPECIAL / Philly Cheesesteak / 2× 🪙; tapping it routes to /game?dishId=cheesesteak&level=1. (2) /game order panel shows subtitle '⭐ Daily Special — 2× coins!' when dishId matches today's special. (3) /shop after onboarding renders grill-upgrade-card with title 'Bigger Grill', 3 level dots, 'Lv 0/3', upgrade-grill-button 'Upgrade — 150'; tapping with 100 coins shows shop-toast 'Not enough coins!'; booster cards shop-item-* and buy-* still present. (4) /serve?...&daily=1: no combo-streak visible before serving; 1st Perfect serve feedback = 'Perfect! +116 🪙 ⭐2×' (base 50 + ~8 speed = ~58 * 1× * 2× daily), combo-streak badge appears reading '🔥 x1.5'; 2nd Perfect feedback = 'Perfect! +174 🪙 🔥x1.5 ⭐2×' (58 * 1.5 * 2), badge escalates to '🔥 x2.0'; 3rd Wrong serve feedback = 'Wrong order!' and combo-streak badge disappears (streak reset). All spec bullets in the review_request validated. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Non-blocking RN-web warnings for shadow*/textShadow*/Image.resizeMode still present (explicitly OK-to-ignore per review_request).

issues: When the Shop screen is loaded without a stored playerId in AsyncStorage, the header shows 🪙 0 and the upgrade button renders as 'Upgrade — ' (cost blank). This matches the review_request note ('grill card shows without a cost until a player is loaded'), but a Chef-name prompt or a disabled state with placeholder cost would prevent the ambiguous empty-label. Consider redirecting to onboarding from /shop when no id exists, or showing '—' / 'Sign in first' on the button.
RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow*/textShadow* style props and Image.style.resizeMode still emitted; whitelisted by review_request.

action_items: Optional UX: on /shop (and any other player-scoped screen) redirect to onboarding when playerStorage.get() returns null, so users don't see a Shop with 🪙0 and a costless 'Upgrade —' button.
Optional: migrate deprecated RN-web shadow*/textShadow*/Image.resizeMode style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and Home ImageBackground to silence warnings.
Optional (from iteration 2, still open): dead-code cleanup in /app/frontend/src/constants/dishes.ts line 104.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py daily-special: uses UTC ordinal % len(catalog) — deterministic per UTC day, cycles through 8 dishes over 8 days. OK.
server.py upgrade-grill correctly enforces max_level and insufficient-coins BEFORE mutation; grill_cost = 150*(level+1) matches spec 150→300→450 for level 0→2.
server.py player_public exposes grill_level with default 0 for pre-existing docs — good backward compatibility.

serve.tsx combo logic: `mult = 1 + streak*0.5` computed from CURRENT streak BEFORE incrementing, so first perfect pays 1× (streak was 0), second pays 1.5× (streak was 1). The badge text uses `(1+streak*0.5).toFixed(1)` on the NEW streak, so header badge shows x1.5 after 1st perfect / x2.0 after 2nd — this is a small mismatch with the payout multiplier but is intentional 'next-serve preview' UX. Verified visually.

serve.tsx daily bonus applies to both perfect (base*mult*daily) and partial (partial*8*daily) coins — spec says 'perfect-serve coins are doubled' so doubling partial coins is a mild spec deviation; harmless.
game.tsx pre-stock grill: `Math.min(lvl, need-1)` guarantees the level can never auto-complete without ≥1 match. Nice guardrail.
shop.tsx: when player/grill are null (no stored id) the upgrade button still renders enabled with blank cost. Consider disabling until grill != null.
index.tsx: getDailySpecial fetched independently of player load; safe (works pre-onboarding too).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Home daily banner + navigation to /game, Game daily subtitle, Shop grill card + upgrade button + insufficient-coins toast + booster cards, Serve combo streak escalation 1x→1.5x→2x + reset on wrong serve, Serve daily ⭐2× label on perfect feedback with correct 2x coin math)
